title: Requesting the position via smartphone
body_md: With a smartphone a position message designed for that purpose can be requested. Pro-finder replies with a message containing a link; opening it shows the position in a map view without coordinates having to be transferred.
prev_context: Before this stands the paragraph on the GPS status in the report.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 22: equivalent in substance. The command string is not reproduced (BLK-005).
